meta.description: Estimates the minimum biological replicates (or cells/donors) for a target power at a target FDR in genomics experiments using ssizeRNA, PROPER, and pilot-data dispersion estimation from DESeq2/edgeR, including a pseudobulk-on-donors route for scRNA-seq cohort sizing. Covers the biological-versus-technical replication distinction, replicate-number-versus-sequencing-depth budgeting, scRNA-seq sample-versus-cell allocation under a pseudobulk model, and the critique that n=3 is a publication convention rather than a power calculation.

recommendations.title: PROPER code block's headline print line accesses a nonexistent field, silently returns NULL
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md's PROPER block ends with `powres$powerAveraged`, intended as the average power per replicate count. PROPER 1.38.0's comparePower() returns a 16-field list with no field of that name (confirmed against the actual names(powres) output and by searching every exported PROPER function's source for the literal string 'powerAveraged' -- found in none). R's `$` operator on a missing list name returns NULL silently, with no error or warning, so a researcher following this block verbatim gets NULL as their headline sample-size answer from the route the Skill itself calls 'most defensible'.
recommendations.root_cause: The fix log's own verification confirmed the pipeline executes and 'got a real comparePower result object' but did not check that the specific printed accessor actually returns a value -- the same 'exits 0 is not evidence' trap that produced both pre-fix P0s, recurring here in a newly-added, less-scrutinized code block.
recommendations.fix: Replace `powres$powerAveraged` with `powres$power.marginal` (a Nreps x strata matrix; dot-separated, not camelCase). Add one line showing how to summarize it (e.g. `rowMeans(powres$power.marginal)` for average power per Nreps across strata), and add `str(powres)` or `names(powres)` to the block as a fallback the way the Skill already recommends for ssizeRNA API drift.

recommendations.title: PROPER's own comparePower() can itself return NaN power.marginal on a small/sparse pilot
recommendations.problem: Independent inspection of the corrected accessor (power.marginal) on this re-audit's synthetic 6v6 pilot showed it returning NaN across most Nreps/strata cells at nsims=10-20, likely from sparse per-stratum true-discovery counts on a modest pilot.
recommendations.root_cause: PROPER's per-stratum marginal power estimate can be undefined when a stratum has too few genes or simulated discoveries at low nsims; the Skill does not warn about this.
recommendations.fix: After fixing the field-name bug above, add a one-line caveat that power.marginal can return NaN for sparse strata or low nsims, and suggest increasing nsims or nrow(pilot_counts) before trusting a stratum's value, mirroring the existing NaN-true-FDR guidance already written for check.power.
